vulnerability_analysis: The contract has an owner-only function setMaxTxPercent() that allows the owner to set _maxTxAmount based on a percentage of total supply. By passing 0 as the parameter, the owner can set _maxTxAmount to 0, which would cause all non-owner transfers to revert (since amount > 0 would fail the require(amount <= _maxTxAmount) check). This is an owner privilege abuse that could freeze the token for all users except the owner.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call setMaxTxPercent(0) to set _maxTxAmount to 0, demonstrating the owner's ability to abuse their privileges.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Identify the current owner of the contract. 2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 3. Call setMaxTxPercent(0) on the target contract. 4. Verify that _maxTxAmount is now 0.
